capabilities.title: Offline edits
capabilities.summary: You can keep writing when the connection drops: the app keeps every edit and sends it when the connection returns, and a banner says you are offline.

looks.caption: The banner after five seconds offline
Open a note, then turn off the network

requirements.name: Edits made offline are kept
requirements.text: When the connection drops, the app SHALL keep every edit and send it when the connection returns, because a user otherwise loses work.

scenarios.name: An edit made offline reaches the others
The banner shows after five seconds

capabilities.title: Tables
capabilities.summary: Put a table in a note and edit its cells like text.

requirements.name: Cells are edited in place
requirements.text: When a user types in a cell, the app SHALL change only that cell, because a table is edited like text.

scenarios.name: Typing in a cell changes only that cell

capabilities.title: Share links
capabilities.summary: Send anyone a link to a note. The link stops working after the time you chose.

looks.caption: A shared note, opened from its link

requirements.name: A link expires
requirements.text: When the time a link was made for runs out, the service SHALL refuse it, because a shared note is shared for a while.

scenarios.name: An expired link shows that it expired

capabilities.title: Sign-in
capabilities.summary: Sign in once on a trusted device and stay signed in for 30 days.

requirements.name: A trusted device stays signed in
requirements.text: When a user signs in on a trusted device, the service SHALL keep them signed in for 30 days, because signing in each day is a chore.

scenarios.name: A trusted device is still signed in the next day

capabilities.title: Markdown import
capabilities.summary: Turns a folder of Markdown files into notes, keeping their headings, links and pictures.

requirements.name: Headings and links are kept
requirements.text: The importer SHALL keep every heading and link of a Markdown file, because a note should read as the file did.

scenarios.name: A link between files points at the other note
A picture travels with its note

capabilities.title: Import report
capabilities.summary: Each import writes a report of what came in and what was skipped.

requirements.name: Skipped files are named
requirements.text: The importer SHALL name every file it skipped and why, because a silent skip loses notes.

scenarios.name: A file it cannot read is named in the report

capabilities.title: Audit log
capabilities.summary: Every change an admin makes is written to a log they can read.

requirements.name: Admin changes are logged
requirements.text: When an admin changes a setting, the service SHALL log who, what and when, because an admin answers for the change.

scenarios.name: A changed setting is in the log

capabilities.title: Release builds
capabilities.summary: A tagged commit becomes a signed app and a deployed API.

requirements.name: A tag ships
requirements.text: When a version tag is pushed, the pipeline SHALL build, sign and publish the app, because a release is one step.

scenarios.name: A tag publishes a signed build

sides.review: At the desk: open a note, turn off the network and count to five; the banner shows.
